purpose: 纵向关卡固定背景；底部细节向上简化为深蓝渐变

assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: standalone opaque raster backdrop for the vertical 2D side-view Unity game Emergence, first of a cohesive set of three.
Primary request: create ONE tall portrait game background, aspect ratio 2:3, preferably 1024 x 1536. Quiet melancholic blue night in an empty city park. Match the mood of a blue nocturnal park with distant urban silhouettes and tiny warm lamps, but translate it into very simple completely FLAT 2D hand-painted color shapes.
Composition: strict side elevation, no perspective, no vanishing point, no receding path, no three dimensional objects or lighting. All recognizable objects occupy ONLY the bottom 25 percent: a thin muted blue-grey skyline of modest city buildings behind low shrubs, sparse grass, and a small empty park bench silhouette near one side, two tiny lamppost silhouettes with dim amber marks. Keep these decorative distant objects low contrast, softly simplified, unobtrusive, no crisp texture. Lowest 10 percent has a little organic shape detail; 10-25 percent has progressively simpler silhouettes; 25-45 percent fades into broad shapeless blue mist; entire upper 55 percent is EMPTY smooth navy-to-desaturated-indigo gradient color only. Nothing enters from top or sides in upper area. The very top 15 percent should approach a single uniform navy color so the background can continue upward.
Style: subdued flat anime game background, limited 5-7 cool color palette, soft edges, simple silhouette design, not vector sharp, no volumetric shading, no line clutter. Mood: silent, tired, familiar but slightly uneasy, late at night. A black-haired grey-highlight catgirl will be a separate foreground sprite, so DO NOT draw any character. Background should sit quietly behind platforms, protagonist, and animated rising water.
Avoid: people, animals, text, logos, title, watermark, collage, panels, frame, foreground gameplay platforms, collision-looking strong edges, rendered furniture volume, 3D, photorealism, depth of field, realism, dramatic shafts, detailed clouds, stars or moon in upper area, gradients with visible bands, excessively black crushed detail. Produce the complete SINGLE background image, not a presentation.

Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: ONE standalone opaque portrait raster background for a vertical 2D side-view Unity platform game, second in a cohesive quiet blue-night set.
Primary request: tall portrait 2:3 composition, preferably 1024 x 1536, an empty sleeping residential neighborhood and courtyard in flat side elevation. The feel is contemplative and slightly uncanny, familiar urban night, cool muted navy and slate blue with a few tiny dusty amber windows. Not scary or dystopian.
Composition: make recognizable detail confined to the LOWEST quarter of the entire tall canvas. A low horizontal strip of modest apartment fronts, simple window rectangles, a narrow railing seen straight-on, and a few small leaf/shrub silhouettes at the very bottom. Buildings are soft simplified flat CUT PAPER shapes, only front elevations, no visible side walls, no floor perspective, no foreground road receding, no vanishing point, no volumetric lighting. Each building should be modest, low contrast, minimal windows; no giant dominating structure. The lowest 10 percent contains a little line and leaf shape detail; next 15 percent has simpler architectural silhouettes, next 20 percent dissolves into a few broad mist color shapes. Entire UPPER 55 percent must be completely empty, clean smooth dark slate-blue to deep ink-blue gradient. Topmost 15 percent almost uniform ink-blue. Keep side edges empty above the bottom quarter. This layout supports vertical camera travel up a tall level.
Style: entirely flat hand-painted 2D anime scenery, few colors, gentle edges, deliberately low definition, no realism, no volume or cast shadows, no dense texture, tiny warm details only at bottom, overall legible darkness rather than pure black. Same design language as a subdued flat night park scene. Background imagery must be distant and quiet so a separately rendered black-haired grey-highlight catgirl and platform geometry remain readable.
Constraints: no characters or animals, no typography or logos, no waterline or gameplay obstacles, no upper clouds, no moon, no stars, no composition frames, no collage, no bright neon, no depth of field, no 3D, no detailed grunge. A SINGLE full background with no borders.

Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: ONE opaque portrait raster backdrop for vertical 2D game Emergence, third in a consistent blue-night background set.
Primary request: a quiet, slightly unsettling memory of an ordinary BEDROOM that has lost all enclosing walls and roof. Familiar domestic shapes are exposed to the same muted midnight blue void as an empty night park. A flat side-on illustration, NO perspective or volume.
Canvas: tall portrait aspect 2:3, preferably 1024 x 1536. Detail should be concentrated entirely at the bottom, not spread through the canvas.
Composition: all room fragments occupy the LOWEST 22 percent: a very faint low bed silhouette off to one side, a little flat bedside table with one small dim amber lamp mark, a low dresser, a small freestanding rectangular curtain/window-frame memory near the other side, no continuous walls. All objects seen straight-on like muted paper cutouts, no visible top surfaces, no receding floor, no isometric geometry, no oblique furniture corners. The foreground edge is an indistinct soft horizontal mist wash, not a platform. Furniture must read as distant low contrast scenery, not usable or interactive gameplay items. At the bottom tiny restrained fabric and leaf-like shapes give just a hint of detail. By 25 percent up from bottom, silhouettes dissolve into broad desaturated blue and blue-grey shapes; by 45 percent up from bottom, the entire remaining upper area is only a smooth flat-color dark slate/indigo gradient. UPPER 55 percent is empty color gradient only. No architectural element, tree, cloud, moon, stars, particles or lighting reaches into it. Topmost 15 percent nearly uniform deep navy.
Mood: stillness, everyday exhaustion, an intimate familiar room becoming uncontained, gentle unease, dreamlike and understated; no horror. Color palette: 5-7 desaturated navy and dusty blue tones, tiny subdued warm amber at bottom only. Background remains dark but subtle forms are readable.
Style: completely flat 2D anime game backdrop, low detail, soft broad shape boundaries, no heavy texture, no realistic rendering, no 3D depth, no shading gradients on object surfaces, no volumetric light, no strong cast shadows, no crisp outlines. Designed to sit behind a separate black-haired grey-highlight catgirl, dark platforms and animated rising water.
Avoid: any people or catgirl, text, logos, watermark, title, detailed illustrated room interior, walls or roof, bright glow, high contrast bed, foreground gameplay assets, hard platform-looking floors, collage, panels, decorative border. ONE complete background image.
assets.final_edit_prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset type: final flat 2D portrait game background.
Input image: the attached image is the edit target.
Change only the furniture rendering in the bottom quarter: flatten the bed, bedside chest, dresser and standing curtain into very simple FRONT-ELEVATION blue silhouette shapes, with one or at most two flat tones per object. Remove all visible top planes, diagonal receding sides, bevels, object shading, specular detail, volumetric quilt folds and cast shadows. A bed becomes a faint straight-on headboard with a single flat draped sheet shape; bedside table and dresser become flat rectangular silhouettes with a few muted horizontal drawer marks; the curtain a simple soft rectangular shape with only a few low contrast vertical strokes. Reduce the leaves at the bottom a little too. Keep it a faint distant decorative room memory.
Preserve exactly: tall 2:3 canvas dimensions and composition, all objects restricted to the bottom 25 percent, the quiet melancholy blue-night mood, no enclosing walls or roof, the nearly empty upper 75 percent, tiny dim amber lamp, overall dark indigo palette and low contrast. Keep the upper smooth gradient and make it untextured flat color. No additional objects or characters. No text, logo, watermark, border, collage, realistic texture, perspective, volume, or 3D. This is a purely 2D flat side-view background; the furniture must look like soft flat cut-paper shapes.
